skill.displayName: AI Xray Clothes – Free AI Clothes Replacer Tool – API-powered
skill.summary: AI x-ray clothes filter — make clothing appear sheer and see-through

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ai-xray-clothes-openapi-skill (v1.0.0).
- Enables the AI x-ray filter to make clothing appear sheer or see-through in images.
- Requires HTTPS and a WeShop API key for use; retrieve your key at https://open.weshop.ai/authorization/apikey.
- Supports image upload, custom sheer instructions, and batch processing (1–16 images).
- Detailed API usage guidance and security best practices included.
